description: Wave 1b: finish the D0.7 triage. W1-D1/D2 covered 124 of the 235 unlinked .cpp (Save/Gameplay/Input/Particle, then Util/Audio). These three units cover the remaining ~111 across Render, Frontend, HUD, Boot, Vehicle, Ai, Collision, Race, Compat and the singletons. Pure Read/Grep/Glob, off-quota.

units.prompt:
READ-ONLY. ROADMAP D0.7 triage, part 3. CONTEXT AND METHOD ARE SETTLED; use them rather than re-deriving. The exe source list in mashedmod\build.bat names 198 of the 433 .cpp files, and those are what reach mashed_re.exe; the rest reach only the dev .asi via mashedmod/asi_sources.rsp. Two findings from parts 1-2 (committed at re/orchestrator/read_fleet/runs/w1_relink/) govern your classification:

(1) RH_ScopedInstall is NOT a boot hazard and is NOT a class-C trigger. Core/HookSystem.h:37-43 expands it to a file-scope object whose ctor calls HookSystem::Register(RVA, &fn) - the RVA is passed as an INTEGER and never dereferenced - and in the exe that symbol resolves to a no-op whose definition lives in Stubs\HookSystemNoOp.cpp (build.bat:212). Util/UtilLeaves.cpp has the identical shape and has been linked and booting all along. Do not flag it.

(2) The ONLY class-C trigger is a file-scope (column-0) initializer that DEREFERENCES an absolute MASHED address at load, i.e. a leading '*' on the initializer, the shape build.bat:101 names: static const GUID g = *reinterpret_cast<const GUID*>(0x005d09dc). The known offenders so far are Audio/AudioDSound.cpp:95-96 (deref, confirmed) and Audio/AudioRws.cpp:477-490 (binds an RVA to a global without deref - will NOT fault the loader, flagged conservatively).

YOUR SCOPE: every .cpp under Render/ and Rws/ that is NOT on build.bat's exe source list. Read build.bat and asi_sources.rsp first to determine that set exactly (Render/ is 53 files with 17 linked; Rws/ is 2 with 1 linked).

Classify each: (A) UNLINKED-BY-INTENT - self-test or pure .asi harness code; (B) SAFE-TO-ADD - no file-scope construct dereferencing or binding a MASHED address; (C) BLOCKED - names the exact construct and line.

Because the exe already links 17 Render files, ALSO report per class-B file whether it has a cross-TU link dependency on a symbol defined only in an UNLINKED file - those are link errors, not boot crashes, and they dictate add-back ORDER.

CRITICAL SECOND COLUMN - this is the column that decides real value, not linkage: for each class-B file, report whether it contains ANY MASHED absolute address (0x00400000-0x00b60000) in a NON-COMMENT code path. Files with ZERO such addresses are FUNCTIONAL standalone and can be linked immediately. Files with them are merely load-safe: they become dead exports whose bodies would AV if called, because the exe bases at 0x10000. Grep for the address pattern and exclude comment lines; report the count and 2-3 example line numbers per file.

Produce: (1) a per-file table: file | class | RVA-free? (YES/NO + count) | C4 rows | C3 rows (from hooks.csv, file column) | blocking construct with line if class C | cross-TU deps. (2) An ORDERED ADD-BACK LIST containing ONLY the RVA-free class-B files, ranked by C4 then C3 unlocked - these are the ones worth linking now. (3) A separate list of load-safe-but-RVA-tunnelled files ranked by C4, as the porting backlog. (4) Counts per class. Cite file:line for every class-C verdict. NO-GUESSING: if you cannot tell whether a construct runs at load time, mark [UNCERTAIN] and classify C. Do NOT write any file.
